notes.title: Your opinion is important to us
notes.content:
Hey guys!
We appreciate your interest and your feedback.
And you can help us make our app much better by taking this simple survey:


1. What do you do?
A. Gamedev narrative designer
B. Screen writer
C. Studying the Screenwriting 
D. Writing books as a hobby
E. Author
F. Dungeon master / Game master
G. Other 

2. What are the Tarot for Storytelling app`s goals?

3. Version you appreciate
A. desktop
B. mobile
C. both

4. Rate the visual from 1 to 10

5. What is a fair cost for the app now?

6. What of the following would you like us to improve? (please, write the details)
A. UX/UI 
B. Application stability
C. Visual style
D. Visual effects
E. Other languages support
F. Stories and description of cards
F. The functionality of the app
G. Other 

Thanks for support!

Vepsän Vändod team
